grpo.data: On-policy samples from the train split only. Held-out tasks and held-out evaluator files are excluded from the update.
grpo.reward: reward.decide(result).reward recomputed from retained grade stdout. Do not optimize grader.score: on performance tasks that score is 0 whenever the speedup threshold fails, including when hidden correctness passed.

no_update.role: Frozen weights. Same held-out evaluation budget as the learning arms. Training compute is not matched by dummy updates.

sft.data: Behavior cloning on the frozen oracle patches for the train split only, one pass. This is an oracle-patch control, not a claim that the model discovered the fixes. Held-out oracle files are not training data.

claim_boundary: Prepared comparison config. It does not contain a trainer and does not authorize execution. A point estimate from three seeds is not a positive result unless the acceptance rule below holds.

metrics.acceptance: For each of the two primary contrasts, all three seeds have a strictly positive paired difference and the 2.5 percentile of the 10000-resample seed bootstrap of the mean paired difference is greater than 0. Report both contrasts. A point estimate alone is not acceptance.
metrics.per_seed_statistic: Unweighted mean of protocol success (1 or 0) across the four frozen held-out tasks.
secondary: mean shaped protocol reward on the held-out split

runner.note: scripts/run_mlsys_coding_policy_comparison_v1.py refuses before any model, container, or update.

stopping_rule: Do not start without isolation clearance for this manifest hash. Do not add tasks, edit the split, or change the speedup threshold, repeat count, or reward cap after any arm records a score. Stop an arm that exceeds its wall or RSS cap and retain the failure.
